goal: Deliver a premium, comprehensive and easy VII administration product rather than a collection of technical reports.

intent_model.literal_request: Improve the appearance and functionality of the management system by an order of magnitude.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A daily operating cockpit that feels comparable to a mature marketplace back office, keeps advanced depth reachable and turns real site activity into obvious actions.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: A material system-level transformation, not a cosmetic color change.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Requires shared-shell, dashboard, representative workflow and growth-tool improvements with live visual proof.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: What needs attention now and whether the system is healthy.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose the one priority task or one bounded operational module.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the relevant workflow directly from the priority or command surface.

facts.claim: The live system currently exposes nine administration modules.
Business events, search opportunities, catalog runs, bookings, reviews and saved WhatsApp leads have existing D1-backed APIs.
facts.evidence: Existing app/api/admin routes and D1 storage modules.

assumptions.claim: The existing Google administrator allowlist remains the correct authorization boundary.
assumptions.validation: Keep the current session and allowlist checks unchanged and rerun unauthorized route tests.

in_scope: Shared administration shell and command navigation
responsive loading, error, empty and authorization states
out_of_scope: Creating or changing external GA4, Search Console or Tag Manager accounts
invariants: All current administration URLs remain reachable
Existing Google allowlist authorization remains enforced
No supplier data is pulled by the redesign
Search-page save, scheduling and version behavior is unchanged
Public catalog and booking behavior are unchanged

requirements.statement: The administration home must present real operational health, priority work and measurable site activity with clear next actions.
Business performance must show impressions, page entries, unique browsers, calls, saved WhatsApp leads and booking requests with visible funnel ratios, filtering and export.
requirements.source: User's earlier explicit dashboard requirements and ADIR-DATA-001

requirements.statement: Search-derived page opportunities must remain visible as an actionable review queue that leads directly to editing and publishing.
Promotion tooling must be collected in a growth center that distinguishes working VII capabilities from unverified external integrations.
requirements.source: User's explicit promotion-area request and ADIR-WEB-CMS-001

requirements.statement: The shared administration experience must be coherent, modern, keyboard accessible and responsive at 390px without losing capabilities.
requirements.source: Current request, VII feedback standard and applicable lessons

requirements.statement: Existing data, routes, permissions and public behavior must not regress, and publication must have a rollback identity.

acceptance_checks.setup: Authorized account opens /admin with existing data.
acceptance_checks.action: Wait for the dashboard to load.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Health, priorities, KPIs, catalog state and recent activity appear with direct task actions and explicit data periods.

acceptance_checks.action: Change period, search, filter and export.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The same filtered rows and funnel totals remain internally consistent and a CSV export is generated locally.

acceptance_checks.setup: Search opportunities exist or the queue is empty.
acceptance_checks.action: Open the queue and choose an item or inspect the empty state.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each item shows demand, results, readiness, priority and a direct editing action; the empty state explains how data appears.

acceptance_checks.setup: Authorized account opens the growth center.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect technical and editorial growth modules.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Sitemap, robots, first-party measurement, search content, redirects and promotion tools show truthful status and direct destinations; external systems are not falsely shown as connected.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open representative routes on desktop and 390x844 mobile.
acceptance_checks.action: Use global navigation, command search and primary controls.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The current location is clear, controls are reachable, Hebrew typography is modern and there is no page-level horizontal overflow.

acceptance_checks.setup: Simulate API error or unauthorized access.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A branded actionable state appears without exposing management data.

acceptance_checks.action: Load and reload existing saved data without changing it.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Data and route behavior remain intact after the shared-shell redesign.

acceptance_checks.action: Publish through the versioned Site workflow.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The new version and prior public version are both identified and the live routes are verified after publication.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, tests and rollback-safe publication are authorized by the active VII instructions; no supplier pull, external account change, message or purchase is authorized.
